longDescription: Personnel Prerequisites Identification. Personnel Matching To Organisational Prerequisites. Basic Prerequisite Factors. External Factors Influencing Human Resource. Professional Certificate in Determining Human Resource Requirements aims to focus and prepare the learner to explore key concepts and underlying dynamics of the human resource requirements.
